examples.arabic: امبارح اشتريت غرض بس طلع غلط
examples.english: Yesterday I bought an item but it turned out to be wrong.
examples.transliteration: Imbāreḥ ishtarēt gharaḍ bas ṭiliʿ ghalaṭ
examples.storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

examples.arabic: بس بعدين عرفت اني رجعت الغلط
examples.english: But then I realized I had returned the wrong one.

examples.arabic: امبارح اشتريت قميص بس كان قياسه غلط
examples.english: Yesterday I bought a shirt, but it was the wrong size
examples.transliteration: Imbāriḥ ishtarēt qamīṣ bas kān qiyāso ghalaṭ
examples.storyTitle: Returning an Item to the Shop

examples.arabic: صاحب المحل ضحك كتير وقلي هاد جزدان العاب للاطفال بالغلط
examples.english: The shop owner laughed a lot and told me this was a toy wallet for children by mistake.
examples.transliteration: Ṣāḥib el-maḥall ḍiḥik kteer w-qali hād jizdān al3āb lil-aṭfāl bil-ghalaṭ.
